system.name: DPOK
system.one_liner: Online RL fine-tuning of text-to-image diffusion models by policy gradient with KL regularisation, against reward-weighted supervised fine-tuning.

content.variant_note: two panels redraw the same model, sample and reward loop in the same colours: a fixed pre-generated dataset in (a), fresh samples each round in (b); (b) is also an iteration-rounds column with one real image per round
content.argues: Reward-weighted supervised fine-tuning updates the model on a fixed dataset from the pre-trained model, whereas online RL keeps sampling from the model being trained.
content.subject: Two training loops for a text-to-image model: a fixed dataset of rabbit images versus fresh samples each round, both scored by a reward function.

new_tags.name: offline-vs-online-data-loop
new_tags.what: two panels redrawing the same model, sample and reward loop to contrast a fixed pre-generated dataset with fresh samples drawn from the updated model each round

lessons.what_to_learn: To contrast offline and online training, redraw the same three boxes (model, samples, reward) in two panels with identical colours per role and change only where the samples come from: one fixed grid of thumbnails in (a) versus one fresh sample per round in (b), with hollow block arrows labelled Model update between rounds.
lessons.suits: training-procedure comparisons (supervised versus RL, offline versus online, fixed versus refreshed data) where the data source is the difference.

evidence: Both start with the same pre-trained model (the blue rectangle).
In supervised fine-tuning, the model is updated on a fixed dataset generated by the pre-trained model.
the model is updated using new samples from the previously trained model during online RL fine-tuning

summary: DPOK fine-tunes text-to-image diffusion models with online reinforcement learning (policy gradient with KL regularisation) instead of reward-weighted supervised fine-tuning. Figure 1 contrasts the two in lettered panels that reuse the same colours: blue for the pre-trained model p_pre, cream for the updated model p_θ, green for the reward function. In (a), eight rabbit images from the pre-trained model sit in a grey frame, are scored once by a reward function, and feed a chain of hollow Model update arrows from p_pre to p_θ. In (b), three rounds in a column each show the model, a freshly generated rabbit and a reward function with a curved loop-back arrow, joined by hollow Model update arrows, the rabbit getting greener.
summary_zh: DPOK 用在线强化学习微调文生图扩散模型，对比奖励加权的监督微调。图分 (a)(b) 两栏、同色同角色：(a) 为预训练模型生成的八张兔子图一次性打分后链式更新；(b) 为三轮循环，每轮新生成图像、打分并回传奖励，兔子越来越绿。
notes: The prior order was changed: the caption frames the figure as (a) versus (b), so side-by-side-contrast leads; (b) is also an iteration-rounds walkthrough. That the target is green rabbits is read off the images only. The same rabbit image (grey rabbit with a green vest) appears in the (a) grid and as the round-1 sample of (b).
